title: Breakline
description: Carve a 1.8 km mountain, chain tricks and grinds, and stay ahead of a Yeti and polar bear in a third-person arcade snowboarding chase.

prompt.objective: Build a fast downhill snowboarding chase with tricks and relentless pursuers.

mintAssets.brief: Alpine props and five terrain-park jumps.
A rider and Yeti with chase, trick, hit, and victory motions.
Snow, ice, rock, bark, metal, clothing, and board surfaces.
Wind, music, carving, grinding, landings, boosts, and roars.

experience: Carve and chain tricks while two pursuers close in.
Support keyboard, gamepad, and touch controls.
prompt.visualDirection: Bright alpine arcade action with teal accents, powder trails, and a clean sports HUD.

thumbnail.alt: A snowboarder carves through a bright alpine course as the HUD tracks closing polar bear and Yeti pursuers.

social.title: Breakline
social.description: Carve, trick, grind, and outrun two mountain pursuers.
